_what_this_is: the executable set a Phase-C2 baseline-completion session would run, derived live by the same import walk every other experiment's closure uses. `derive` RAISES on an unresolved internal import, so a digest existing at all means the set is closed.
_informational_until_an_authorization_bi: no grant or authorization exists for this session, so this digest pins nothing yet. It is here so a reviewer can see WHAT would run and so the authorization step binds a derived figure rather than an invented one.
_unresolved_rule: zero by construction: aadistill.governance.closure.derive raises ClosureError rather than returning a set smaller than what runs

excludes_the_beam._meaning: the beam runner and the Search-1 launcher/driver are not in the set this session executes. A completion grant binds this digest, so it cannot pay for code that is not in it.

search_1_closure_for_comparison._note: Search-1's digest moves whenever a shared file does -- this round the setup script gained the completion's SESSION_KIND branch and the comparison builder gained its interpretation parameter. Search-1's chain is consumed and closed, so nothing needs to match its old value.

_grew_this_round: the formal plumbing round added the completion's readiness contract, its bundle transport, its authorization assembler and its instance config to what a completion session executes, and the launcher now imports the first two. A larger set is the point: every file the session would run is in the digest a grant binds.
